|---|---|
| `TurboDL-Setup-0.8.1.exe` | Windows 10/11 (x64) |
| `TurboDL-0.8.1-arm64.dmg` | macOS on Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) |

## What's new

- **An account's stories link.** `instagram.com/stories/<username>/` now opens that account's current stories, all of them, to pick from or download. Before, only a link to one story (`/stories/<username>/<story>/`) opened, and this one was refused with "TurboDL opens Instagram posts, reels, stories and highlights". It works in the app, the command line, the local API and Python.

Instagram shows current stories only to signed-in visitors, so story links still need a sign-in. You can sign in to Instagram once in TurboDL. If you are already signed in to Instagram in your browser, you can use **Open in TurboDL** there instead: the link reaches TurboDL with your browser's session. Highlights still work without signing in.

Everything else is as in 0.8.0.

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once.
- **Extension.** The browser extension has not changed; there is nothing to reload.
- **Firefox.** Open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.8.1.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla. If this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.
- **Linux.** `sudo apt install ./TurboDL-0.8.1-amd64.deb`, or replace the AppImage and start it once from its new place.

The Windows installer is not signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
